genesis.47.p1.b1.text: My father and my brothers, … have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen.

genesis.47.p1.b2.text: And he chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.

genesis.47.p1.b4.text: Your servants are shepherds, … both we and our fathers. … So now, please allow your servants to settle in the land of Goshen.

genesis.47.p1.b5.text: the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land. They may dwell in the land of Goshen.

genesis.47.p2.b1.text: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and presented him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

genesis.47.p2.b2.text: How many years have you lived?

genesis.47.p2.b3.text: My travels have lasted 130 years, … My years have been few and hard, and they have not matched the years of the travels of my fathers.

genesis.47.p2.b4.text: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and departed from his presence.

genesis.47.p3.b1.text: Joseph … gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses,

genesis.47.p3.b2.text: Joseph also provided his father and brothers and all his father’s household with food for their families.

genesis.47.p3.b3.text: There was no food, however, in all that region, because the famine was so severe; … exhausted by the famine.

genesis.47.p3.b4.text: Joseph collected all the money to be found in the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan … and he brought it into Pharaoh’s palace.

genesis.47.p4.b1.text: Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? For our funds have run out!

genesis.47.p4.b2.text: he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their flocks and herds, and their donkeys. Throughout that year he provided them with food …

genesis.47.p4.b3.text: There is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land. … Purchase us and our land in exchange for food. … Give us seed that we may live and not die, …

genesis.47.p5.b1.text: the Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields because the famine was so severe upon them. The land became Pharaoh’s,

genesis.47.p5.b2.text: However, he did not acquire the priests’ portion of the land, for it had been given to them by Pharaoh.

genesis.47.p5.b3.text: here is seed for you to sow in the land. … you are to give a fifth of it to Pharaoh, and four-fifths will be yours …

genesis.47.p5.b4.text: You have saved our lives, … We have found favor in our lord’s eyes, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

genesis.47.p6.b1.text: Now the Israelites settled in the land of Egypt, in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and became fruitful and increased greatly in number.

genesis.47.p6.b2.text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and the length of his life was 147 years.

genesis.47.p7.b1.text: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called his son Joseph …

genesis.47.p7.b2.text: put your hand under my thigh and promise to show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,

genesis.47.p7.b3.text: I will do as you have requested.

genesis.47.p7.b5.text: So Joseph swore to him, and Israel bowed in worship at the head of his bed.
